title: Paul McCartney live: The Palace, Auburn Hills | 2005
content:
Paul McCartney performed at The Palace in Auburn Hills, Michigan, USA, on 14 October 2005.

It was the 14th show of the US Tour, which lasted for 37 dates between September and November 2005, and the first of two consecutive nights in Auburn Hills.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

McCartney had previously performed at The Palace on 1 and 2 February 1990 during the Paul McCartney World Tour, and 1 May 2002 for the Driving World Tour.
